integrity: The analytic proof is self-contained conditional on standard Kirchhoff Green and Foster identities. Exact-rational verification is finite corroboration, not an infinite proof or independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: No vertex atoms, nonconstant edge densities, arbitrary self-adjoint couplings, or higher Laplacian powers. Fourth-degree coefficient does not alone select maximizing sites. Historical spline-kernel priority risk remains.
scientific_scope: Finite connected loopless metric multigraphs; arbitrary positive edge lengths; unweighted arclength; real zero-mean Kirchhoff Laplacian domain; sharp squared H² point evaluations.
title: Quartic edge envelopes for sharp biharmonic Sobolev evaluation on metric graphs
